title: Exact comparison of the supported diagonal component formula
statement: Let A be finite, N positive annihilating A, and S Noetherian and N-invertible. Let c be the normalized ordinary Chern arrow for P1 over P1(S), and let kappa be the normalized supported Kummer boundary of the product diagonal. Let cDelta be a pro-etale Cartier class satisfying its specified comparison equation [def-sp-cartier-derived-realization]. With the canonical exact diagonal direct-image realization and the canonical composition and chart maps, the composite before the trace equals beta times the canonical twisted unit plus the comparison image of the Chern adjunct, for each projection and some base arrow beta. This is DiagonalComponentFormula (geoP1DiagonalComponentData ...) and has no splitting or trace hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply exact comparison to the ordinary supported diagonal component identity, retaining its base arrow beta and its coefficient-one normalized relative Chern component.
The specified Cartier Ext comparison, degree-zero comparisons and shift comparisons identify its exact-derived realization with geoP1CartierDerivedArrow.

The mate of a pasted square is the paste of the mates. Apply this to the diagonal followed by either projection and to the projective-line chart. The source and chart comparisons are exactly geoP1DiagonalSource and geoP1DiagonalChartMap; comparison commutes with the normalized twist pullback.

Comparison is additive. The unit and Chern adjunct mate identities identify the two terms as geoP1TwistedUnit and geoP1ChernPushforward. Cancel the invertible closed-source comparison to obtain the displayed component formula.

theorem geoP1_diagonal_comparison_components
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (c : Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S)) ⟶
      (Etale.ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : Etale.ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA (ProjectiveLine S)
      ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S) ↘ ProjectiveLine S).appTop.hom N) ▸
        ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
          hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom).map
            (ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S) ↘ ProjectiveLine S).appTop.hom) c)
    (hI : (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).ker.IsInvertible)
    (κ : Ext
      ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))).obj
        (Etale.ordinaryFiniteConstant A (ProjectiveLine S)))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) N A hA) 2)
    (hκ : Etale.SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA
      (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) hI
      ((map_natCast ((pullback.fst (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) ≫
        (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).appTop.hom N) ▸
          hS.map ((pullback.fst (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) ≫
            (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).appTop.hom) κ)
    (cΔ : GeoCartierClass A N hA (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)))
    [hE : PreservesFiniteColimits
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)))]
    (hcompat : SpP1CartierCompatibility
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)))
      (geoCartierSourceComparison A (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))) κ cΔ) :
    DiagonalComponentFormula (geoP1DiagonalComponentData A N hN hA S hS c cΔ)
